owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.releaseToFreelancer: If true, release payment to freelancer; otherwise refund client

params._marketplace: The address of the Marketplace contract

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

deposit(uint256,address).notice: Deposit payment into escrow for a job

dispute(uint256,string).notice: Raise a dispute for a job in escrow

pause().notice: Pause the contract in case of emergency

refund(uint256).notice: Refund escrow payment to client if job is cancelled

release(uint256).notice: Release escrow payment to freelancer after job completion

resolveDispute(uint256,bool).notice: Manually resolve a dispute by owner
